def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import itertools
def sym_shapes(cells):
    ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
    norm=lambda pts: tuple(sorted((y-min(y2 for y2,x2 in pts), x-min(x2 for y2,x2 in pts)) for y,x in pts))
    pts=list(cells); out=set()
    cur=pts
    for _ in range(4):
        out.add(norm(cur)); out.add(norm([(y,-x) for y,x in cur]))
        cur=[(x,-y) for y,x in cur]  # rotate
    return out
for name,bg in [('Demo pair 1 input',8),('Demo pair 2 input',2),('Test input',9)]:

def solve(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=lib.components(g,bg,diag=True)
    # L = object with the longest straight run (row or col)
    def maxrun(s):
        best=1
        for axis in (0,1):
            d=Counter(p[axis] for p in s)
            ys=sorted(d)
            run=1
            for a,b in zip(ys,ys[1:]):
                run = run+1 if b==a+1 and d[a]==d[b] else 1
                best=max(best,run)
        return best
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t:maxrun(t[1])); Lc=L[0]
    # twinned colors: colors having an exact same-shape partner of different color
    pairs=[]
    for (c1,s1),(c2,s2) in combinations(cs,2):
        if c1!=c2 and c1!=Lc and c2!=Lc and lib.norm_shape(s1)==lib.norm_shape(s2):
            pairs.append((c1,s1,c2,s2))
    if not pairs: return g
    twcolors={c for p in pairs for c in (p[0],p[2])}
    tgt=min(twcolors,key=lambda c:abs(c-Lc))
    # recolor objects of tgt color that have a twin, in the largest pair
    cand=[p for p in pairs if tgt in (p[0],p[2])]
    c1,s1,c2,s2=max(cand,key=lambda p:len(p[1])+len(p[3]))
    s = s1 if c1==tgt else s2
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (y,x) in s: out[y][x]=Lc
    return out
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    r=solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    ok&=r; print(k,r)
print('ALL',ok)

def solve(g):
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=lib.components(g,bgc,diag=True)
    def maxrun(s):
        best=1
        for axis in (0,1):
            d=Counter(p[axis] for p in s); ys=sorted(d); run=1
            for a,b in zip(ys,ys[1:]):
                run=run+1 if b==a+1 and d[a]==d[b] else 1
                best=max(best,run)
        return best
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t_:maxrun(t_[1])); Lc=L[0]
    pairs=[(c1,s1,c2,s2) for (c1,s1),(c2,s2) in combinations(cs,2)
           if c1!=c2 and c1!=Lc and c2!=Lc and lib.norm_shape(s1)==lib.norm_shape(s2)]
    tw={c for p in pairs for c in (p[0],p[2])}
    tgt=min(tw,key=lambda c:(abs(c-Lc),c))
    cand=[p for p in pairs if tgt in (p[0],p[2])]
    c1,s1,c2,s2=max(cand,key=lambda p:len(p[1])+len(p[3]))
    s=s1 if c1==tgt else s2
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for y,x in s: out[y][x]=Lc
    return out

def feats(g):

def maxrun(s):

def solve2(g):
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(g,bgc,diag=True)]
    def maxrun(s):
        best=1
        for axis in (0,1):
            d=Counter(p[axis] for p in s); ys=sorted(d); run=1
            for a,b in zip(ys,ys[1:]):
                run=run+1 if b==a+1 and d[a]==d[b] else 1
                best=max(best,run)
        return best
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t_:maxrun(t_[1]))
    others=[t for t in cs if t!=L]
    def mind(t): return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in t[1] for y2,x2 in L[1])
    near=min(others,key=mind)
    twin=[t for t in others if t!=near and t[0]!=near[0] and lib.norm_shape(t[1])==lib.norm_shape(near[1])]
    tgt = twin[0] if twin else near
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for y,x in tgt[1]: out[y][x]=L[0]
    return out

def lscore(s):
    s=set(s); runs=[]
    for (dy,dx) in [(0,1),(1,0)]:
        for (y,x) in s:
            if (y-dy,x-dx) in s: continue
            L_=0; cy,cx=y,x
            while (cy,cx) in s: L_+=1; cy+=dy; cx+=dx
            runs.append(L_)
    runs.sort(reverse=True)
    if len(runs)<2: return (0,0)
    n=len(s)
    exact = 1 if n==runs[0]+runs[1]-1 else 0
    return (exact, runs[0]+runs[1])

def analyze(n):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(gi,bgc,diag=True)]
    Lc=max(cs,key=lambda t_:(lscore(t_[1]),len(t_[1])))
    corner=min(Lc[1],key=lambda p:sum(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in Lc[1]))
    changed=[(y,x,gi[y][x],go[y][x]) for y in range(len(gi)) for x in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[y][x]!=go[y][x]]
    chcells={(y,x) for y,x,_,_ in changed}
    def mind(t): return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in t[1] for y2,x2 in Lc[1])
    def mindc(t): return min(abs(y-corner[0])+abs(x-corner[1]) for y,x in t[1])
    print(f'--- demo {n} bg={bgc} L={Lc[0]} corner={corner} nL={len(Lc[1])} changed={changed[0][2]}->{changed[0][3]}')
    for c,s in sorted([t for t in cs if t!=Lc],key=lambda t:mind(t)):
        mark='*' if chcells & s else ' '
        print(f' {mark} c={c} n={len(s)} dL={mind((c,s))} dC={mindc((c,s))} shape={lib.norm_shape(s)} cells={sorted(s)}')
for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6]: analyze(n)

def feats(n):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(gi,bgc,diag=True)]
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t_:(lscore(t_[1]),len(t_[1])))
    Ls=L[1]
    corner=min(Ls,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in Ls if q!=p))
    ends=[p for p in Ls if sum((abs(p[0]-y)<=1 and abs(p[1]-x)<=1) for y,x in Ls if (y,x)!=p)==1]
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y][x]!=go[y][x]}
    others=[t for t in cs if t!=L]
    colcnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    def shapes(strict=True):
        out={}
        for i,(c,s) in enumerate(others):
            k=lib.norm_shape(s)
            if not strict: k=tuple(sorted({(min(abs(a)+ (1 if (dx,dy)==(0,1) else 0),1) if False else 0,0)})) # placeholder
            out.setdefault(k,[]).append(i)
        return out
    # rotation-invariant key: canonical over 4 rotations of norm_shape
    def rotkey(s):
        k=lib.norm_shape(s); best=k
        cur=set(k)
        for _ in range(3):
            cur={(x,-y) for y,x in cur}
            m=min(cur); c2=tuple(sorted((y-m[0],x-m[1]) for y,x in cur))
            best=min(best,c2)
        return best
    for strict in (True,False):
        d={}
        for i,(c,s) in enumerate(others):
            k=lib.norm_shape(s) if strict else rotkey(s)
            d.setdefault(k,[]).append(i)
        globals()[f'pairs_{strict}_{n}']=d
    rows=[]
    for i,(c,s) in enumerate(others):
        dL=min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
        dC=min(abs(y-corner[0])+abs(x-corner[1]) for y,x in s)

def feats(n):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(gi,bgc,diag=True)]
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t_:(lscore(t_[1]),len(t_[1])))
    Ls=L[1]
    corner=min(Ls,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in Ls if q!=p))
    ends=[p for p in Ls if sum((abs(p[0]-y)<=1 and abs(p[1]-x)<=1) for y,x in Ls if (y,x)!=p)==1]
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y][x]!=go[y][x]}
    others=[t for t in cs if t!=L]
    colcnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    def rotkey(s):
        cur=set(s); best=lib.norm_shape(cur)
        for _ in range(3):
            cur={(x,-y) for y,x in cur}
            k=lib.norm_shape(cur); best=min(best,k)
        return best
    res=[]
    for i,(c,s) in enumerate(others):
        dL=min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
        dC=min(abs(y-corner[0])+abs(x-corner[1]) for y,x in s)
        dE=min((min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in s) for ey,ex in ends), default=99)
        dn=min(min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in s2) for j,(c2,s2) in enumerate(others) if j!=i)
        twS=sum(1 for j,(c2,s2) in enumerate(others) if j!=i and lib.norm_shape(s2)==lib.norm_shape(s))
        twR=sum(1 for j,(c2,s2) in enumerate(others) if j!=i and rotkey(s2)==rotkey(s))
        touch=any(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2)==1 for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
        bord=any(y in(0,H-1) or x in(0,W-1) for y,x in s)
        res.append(dict(i=i,c=c,n=len(s),dL=dL,dC=dC,dE=dE,dn=dn,twS=twS,twR=twR,touch=touch,bord=bord,
                        ccount=colcnt[c],changed=bool(ch&s),s=sorted(s)))
    return res,L,corner,bgc

allrows={}; allL={}; allcorner={}; allbg={}
for n in range(1,7):
    rows,L,corner,bgc=feats(n); allrows[n]=rows; allL[n]=L; allcorner[n]=corner; allbg[n]=bgc
    print(n,'bg',bgc,'L',L[0])
    for r in rows:
        print('  ',('CH' if r['changed'] else '  '),{k:r[k] for k in ('c','n','dL','dC','dE','dn','twS','twR','touch','bord','ccount')})

steps.input:
gi=G['Test input']
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
print('bg',bgc,'size',H,W)
cs=sorted([(c,sorted(s)) for c,s in lib.components(gi,bgc,diag=True)],key=lambda t:-len(t[1]))
def rotkey(s):
    cur=set(s); best=lib.norm_shape(cur)
    for _ in range(3):
        cur={(x,-y) for y,x in cur}; best=min(best,lib.norm_shape(cur))
    return best
L=max([(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(gi,bgc,diag=True)],key=lambda t:(lscore(t[1]),len(t[1])))
Ls=L[1]; print('L color',L[0],'cells',sorted(Ls))
corner=min(Ls,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in Ls if q!=p))
ends=[p for p in Ls if sum((abs(p[0]-y)<=1 and abs(p[1]-x)<=1) for y,x in Ls if (y,x)!=p)==1]
print('corner',corner,'ends',ends)
inv=[]
for i,(c,s) in enumerate(cs):
    if (c,set(s))==L: continue
    dL=min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
    dC=min(abs(y-corner[0])+abs(x-corner[1]) for y,x in s)
    dE=min(min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in s) for ey,ex in ends)
    kS=lib.norm_shape(set(s)); kR=rotkey(set(s))
    twS=[j for j,(c2,s2) in enumerate(cs) if j!=i and lib.norm_shape(set(s2))==kS and (c2,set(s2))!=L]
    twR=[j for j,(c2,s2) in enumerate(cs) if j!=i and rotkey(set(s2))==kR and (c2,set(s2))!=L]
    touch=any(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2)==1 for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
    inv.append(dict(i=i,c=c,n=len(s),dL=dL,dC=dC,dE=dE,twS=twS,twR=twR,touch=touch,s=s))
for r_ in inv:
    print({k:r_[k] for k in ('c','n','dL','dC','dE','touch')},'twS',[(inv[j]['c'],inv[j]['n'],inv[j]['dL']) for j in r_['twS']],'twR',[(inv[j]['c'],inv[j]['n'],inv[j]['dL']) for j in r_['twR'] if j>i],'cells',r_['s'][:6])

def norm_shape(cells):
    """Cells translated so the top-left of their bounding box is (0,0), as a sorted tuple."""
    ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
    return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys), x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells))

def solve7(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in lib.components(g,bgc,diag=True)]
    L=max(cs,key=lambda t:(lscore(t[1]),len(t[1]))); Ls=L[1]; Lc=L[0]
    objs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in cs if (c,set(s))!=L]
    def dL(s): return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
    ends=[p for p in Ls if sum((abs(p[0]-y)<=1 and abs(p[1]-x)<=1) for y,x in Ls if (y,x)!=p)==1]
    def dE(s): return min(min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in s) for ey,ex in ends)
    nontouch=[(c,s) for c,s in objs if dL(s)>1]
    dstar=min(dL(s) for c,s in nontouch)
    ring=[(c,s) for c,s in nontouch if dL(s)==dstar]
    cands=[]
    for c,s in ring:
        k=lib.norm_shape(s)
        for c2,s2 in objs:
            if (c2,s2)!=(c,s) and lib.norm_shape(s2)==k:
                cands.append((dL(s2),-dE(s2),c2,s2))
    tgt=min(cands)[2:4]
    return [[Lc if (y,x) in tgt[1] else g[y][x] for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]

add='''

def lscore(cells):
    """Score of how L-shaped a component is: (exact-L flag, sum of its two longest straight runs)."""
    ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
    rows=Counter(ys); cols=Counter(xs)
    runs=[max(rows.values()), max(cols.values())]
    runs.sort(reverse=True)
    return (len(cells)==runs[0]+runs[1]-1, runs[0]+runs[1])

def twin_recolor_to_anchor_l(grid, lscore=lscore, norm_shape=norm_shape, components=components):
    """Recolor, to the L's color, the same-shape twin of the object(s) closest (non-touching) to the L."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in components(grid,bgc,diag=True)]
    Lm=max(cs,key=lambda t:(lscore(t[1]),len(t[1]))); Ls=Lm[1]; Lc=Lm[0]
    objs=[(c,set(s)) for c,s in cs if (c,set(s))!=Lm]
    dL=lambda s: min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in s for y2,x2 in Ls)
    ends=[p for p in Ls if sum((abs(p[0]-y)<=1 and abs(p[1]-x)<=1) for y,x in Ls if (y,x)!=p)==1]
    dE=lambda s: min(min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in s) for ey,ex in ends)
    nontouch=[(c,s) for c,s in objs if dL(s)>1]
    dstar=min(dL(s) for c,s in nontouch)
    cands=[]
    for c,s in [(c,s) for c,s in nontouch if dL(s)==dstar]:
        k=norm_shape(s)
        for c2,s2 in objs:
            if (c2,s2)!=(c,s) and norm_shape(s2)==k:
                cands.append((dL(s2),-dE(s2),c2,s2))
    tgt=min(cands)[2:4]
    return [[Lc if (y,x) in tgt[1] else grid[y][x] for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]
'''
